description: This Java source file defines an abstract class AbstractPolicyMappingStrategies that provides utility methods for mapping Adaptable objects to various policy-related models, such as Policy, PolicyEntry, Resource, Subject, etc. It appears to be part of a policy management or enforcement component within a larger Eclipse Ditto project, facilitating conversion between protocol adaptables and policy representations.

classes.name: AbstractPolicyMappingStrategies
classes.description: Provides helper methods to map from Adaptable objects to policy models such as policies, policy entries, resources, and subjects, using JSON payloads and path analysis.

methods.name: policyIdFromTopicPath
methods.description: Constructs a PolicyId from a given TopicPath by extracting namespace and id.

methods.name: policyFrom
methods.description: Creates a Policy object from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: policyEntryFrom
methods.description: Creates a PolicyEntry object from an Adaptable's payload, associating it with a label.

methods.name: policyEntriesFrom
methods.description: Retrieves iterable of PolicyEntry objects from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: resourceFrom
methods.description: Creates a Resource object from an Adaptable, using a resource key and payload.

methods.name: resourcesFrom
methods.description: Creates Resources object from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: labelFrom
methods.description: Extracts a Label from the Adaptable's message path.

methods.name: entryResourceKeyFromPath
methods.description: Extracts a ResourceKey from a MessagePath based on path structure.

methods.name: entrySubjectIdFromPath
methods.description: Extracts a SubjectId from a MessagePath based on path structure.

methods.name: subjectFrom
methods.description: Creates a Subject object from an Adaptable using the subject identifier from path and payload.

methods.name: subjectsFrom
methods.description: Creates Subjects object from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: getValueFromPayload
methods.description: Private helper that retrieves a non-null JSON object from the Adaptable's payload value.
